Wait no - initially Y was at col 22 (right of player at col 20-21). Now Y is at col 20 (left of player at col 21-22). So when the player moved LEFT (from col 20-21 to col 21-22... wait that's RIGHT not LEFT).
Hmm, let me reconsider. Initial player: (37,20)-(40,21). Current player: (37,21)-(40,22). The player moved RIGHT by 1 column. But the history shows I moved LEFT at transition 0 and transition 36.
Wait - transition 0 was LEFT, and transition 36 was LEFT. But the player is now at col 21-22 vs initial col 20-21. That's a net movement of +1 column (RIGHT). So I must have moved RIGHT more than LEFT.
Let me trace: transition 0 was LEFT (player moved left), transition 20 was RIGHT (player moved right), transition 36 was LEFT (player moved left), transition 44 was LEFT (player moved left).
Actually, I'm getting confused. Let me just focus on what needs to happen now.

- Player at bottom (row 37-40)
- Yellow next to player
- No green blocks

Let me try ACTION7 to see what happens.
